FN-RJVVMYY-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 36
Committee: County and Municipal Government Sponsor: Senator Wes Kitchens
Analyst: Riley Aaron Date: 02/10/2025
Senate Bill 36 as introduced would require purchases of supplies and services by volunteer fire
departments and rescue squads to be governed by current state law governing other local
government units. This bill would not otherwise directly affect state or local funding.
